blurb: Embark on an unforgettable fishing adventure aboard the Capt. Dave III, a 95’ steel vessel designed for comfort and precision. Choose from a variety of fishing trip options to suit your schedule and preferences. Each trip aims for exceptional fishing opportunities, equipment, and a memorable experience in the scenic waters of Sheepshead Bay,

faq.q: Does the fare include bait, tackle, and rod?
faq.a: A: Yes! We set you up with everything you need to catch the big one! Bait and tackle are included in the fare, rods and additional rigs are available for a minimal fee. Q: What's your schedule? A: Our calendar on fareharbor details all our departure and arrival times, as well as special trips. We sail twice daily: in the morning, and in the evening, everyday Mon-Sun all year and special trip dates/times are listed in the event description. Q: Can I bring my own ?
